heroIntroduction: Thanks to local support, the sale of 28–32 Ellingfort Road has been stopped. Now we need your help to protect the building for the future.
storyHeading: Now we need to secure its future.
storyParagraphOne: For decades, 28–32 Ellingfort Road was home to Hackney Chinese Community Services: a place for connection, support and belonging.
storyParagraphTwo: We are preparing an Asset of Community Value (ACV) application. If you are on the Hackney electoral roll, please add your name and details in support and tell us why you want the space to be kept in community use.
campaignQuote: Sale stopped. Now let’s secure its future.
emailActionText: Send your name and address to londonfieldscommunityspace@gmail.com.
shareActionText: Share the campaign update with neighbours who may be able to support the ACV application.
joinActionText: Include a few lines on why you want the space to be an ACV and kept in community use.
closingText: Email your name, address and a few lines explaining why you want 28–32 Ellingfort Road to have ACV status and be kept in community use.
